The Modbus explanation is on first use in the umbrella as required and word for word as the guardrail has it. The product videos carry no Modbus line, so a viewer of the Lightning video alone gets no sign of the Modbus framing.

Gas cadence is hedged differently. Umbrella states it plainly in narration and the diagram: 'detectors report ... about every half hour', 'WakeCap checks it about every minute'. Gas video softens it: 'every minute or so', 'often half an hour apart'. The gas diagram omits the half hour figure that the umbrella diagram has. G03 is live_today unknown. Pick one hedge.

'Blackline' is first named in the umbrella k04 as page text with no gloss, before the paths section introduces 'vendor'. The gas video glosses it once ('the gas vendor', g11) before the paths diagram. Umbrella viewers meet the name unexplained.

The acknowledge and close statement is hedged differently. Umbrella k04: 'the page says acknowledging or closing is recorded here, with who and when'. Gas g11 states it plainly. Gas g12 then says the timeline and assignee are not available. Use the same attribution to the page, since the frame shows no who or when column.

'Here is the answer, in one strip.' is reused almost verbatim in weather w02 and umbrella c01. 'The page names the offline station. Readiness reads Not ready, and lists why' (weather w05), 'One detector is offline, and the page says so. Readiness reads Not ready, and the list names it' (gas g05) and umbrella s01 are three near copies of one sentence. 'You and your team stay in control' (umbrella z01) repeats a04 'People stay in control'.

Opening hooks all use the same template: a scene, then a question ('Is it safe ...? Where do you look first?', 'The supervisor asks, so what now?', 'What warns the crew first?', 'How would you know?'). Closings all use 'Your next step' (lightning, gas) or 'Next time ... open' (weather) and a 'What is new' list card in three of four. Four videos in a row sound alike.

DIRECTION framing is consistent in the umbrella (badge, ribbon 'DIRECTION . NOT LIVE TODAY', 'could one day', 'The direction:', 'meant to come from'). The captions of a02 and a04 are in present tense ('An assistant proposes. A person approves.'; 'People stay in control') and the diagram guard bar says 'People stay in control: an assistant proposes, a person approves'. Only the ribbon marks them as direction. a01 and a03 captions begin 'Direction:'. a02 and a04 captions do not.

Peak value wording varies for the same report: umbrella 'peak heat index and peak wind speed' and 'peaks, day by day'; weather 'highest heat index and wind speed'; page 'Maximum'. 'Vendor' (videos) vs 'manufacturer' (research safe phrases) vs 'Blackline' (page quote).

'New' is applied unevenly. The umbrella calls the gas status line new (o02). The gas video's own g02 on the same status line is not marked new. The Detectors page (changes: gas-detectors-page, live yes) is not marked new in gas g08. Lightning marks the alarm activity chart 'New' while showing an empty chart.

Wallboard and phone pages: lightning says 'Neither has a menu link. Both open by address.' Gas says nothing about how to reach them, although the research says the gas pages are also not linked from the rail. The two videos describe the same situation differently.

Times: weather w04 says 'Saudi time' plainly on commit evidence (the page prints no zone). Lightning says 'Saudi time' with the page's own 'AST, UTC+3'. Gas shows clock times in frames and says nothing. The two on-screen clocks agree (15:22 on both products), which supports the claim, but the evidence basis differs between the two videos.

Heat index values differ across videos and are all on screen unspoken: 49.5 (weather, umbrella tri), 49.7 (umbrella c01), 50.1 (weather policy), 50.2 (umbrella k01), 41.5 (Project C). The green line 'Last reading was 0 minute(s) ago' next to an online station in the umbrella o02 and 'Last reading was 1 minute(s) ago' in weather w06 are consistent with their frames.

Weather w07 puts a click callout and cursor on the gear while the Select parameters popup is already open, so the 'click' demonstration and the frame disagree. The chapter bar shows 'Weather Station > gear icon' (a click path) over a page the viewer is told only 'you can' use.

coverage_of_user_brief.requirement: Videos are stronger than before: story, visuals and voice
coverage_of_user_brief.where: all four, mostly weather w09 to w13, gas g08 to g13, lightning l05 to l11, umbrella tri scenes and diagrams
coverage_of_user_brief.note: Story is clearly stronger. Each has a concrete hook and one thesis ('A heat number is not an answer', 'what warns the crew first', 'silence is not calm', 'where do you look first'). Spec check passes and lengths are 2:22 to 3:21 at the tool's pace, with the umbrella and weather at the upper limit. Visuals are improved with zooms, spotlight callouts and diagrams, but still weak in places. Tri scenes (umbrella o03, s01, c02; lightning l11) leave the lower half black. Path diagrams (weather w16 to w17, lightning l12 to l13, gas g14 to g15) are a thin strip in a large empty frame. Weather has four consecutive dense Settings pages (about 40 s), gas has six table-heavy beats, the lightning map beats show a blur. The four openings and closings share one template, so the set sounds samey. Voice cannot be judged without the real run, and word counts are at the 2.5 minute ceiling so real pace may overrun.
